name: io.github.hamza533/mcp-postgres-sheets
title: PG Sheets MCP
description: Query PostgreSQL and read/write Google Sheets safely: read-only by default, scoped, fully audited.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection string for a READ-ONLY role (see deploy/sql/001_readonly_role.sql).

environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_SCHEMAS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated schemas the AI may query.

environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_TABLES
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated table allow-list (empty = all tables in ALLOWED_SCHEMAS).

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Google service-account key file (share your sheets with its email).

environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_SHEET_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated spreadsheet IDs the AI may use.

environmentVariables.name: READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true hides the Sheets write tools entirely.

environmentVariables.name: AUDIT_LOG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: File for the JSON-lines audit log (default: stderr).
